verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an official SDK that offers sync and async clients for application code, plus a Cekura SDK used for LiveKit tracing, so the core capability exists first-party. The evidence is only a short docs summary, so its depth and breadth are unproven. Missing for 10: documented language coverage and package/install details, API surface depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
